hero.description: Track shows, collect 2-shots, and celebrate your fandom journey with {highlight} and a beautiful personal dashboard.
hero.openSource: Open Source • No Ads • Fan Made

theater.title: THEATER
theater.description: Track every JKT48 theater show you attend. Monitor your spending, seat history, and watch your fan level grow. See which setlists you've mastered.

twoShot.title: 2-SHOT
twoShot.description: Keep a digital collection of your 2-shot polaroids. Analyze your collection by member and see who's really your oshi with visual breakdown stats.

memories.title: MEMORIES
memories.description: A beautiful digital scrapbook for your fan journey. Store photos, tickets, and special moments in one place. Relive the excitement of every event.

achievements.title: ACHIEVEMENTS
achievements.description: Unlock badges and milestones as you support JKT48. From "First Show" to "Legendary Fan", track your progress and show off your loyalty.

footer.copyright: Crafted with {heart} for the JKT48 Family
footer.disclaimer: This is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by official JKT48 management company.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how MyPage48 collects, uses, and protects your data.

collection.title: Data Collection
collection.content: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, upload tickets, 2-shot photos, or contact us.

usage.title: Data Usage
usage.content: We use your data to provide and improve our services, analyze usage, and personalize your experience.

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.content: We strictly do not sell your personal data to any third parties.

ai.title: AI & Third Party Processing
ai.content: Our ticket scanning feature involves processing data via Google Gemini. Please be aware that data submitted for this specific feature may be used by Google to train and improve their AI models.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.subtitle: How we use cookies to improve your experience

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently and provide information to the owners of the site.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.content: We use cookies to understand how you use our website and to improve your experience. This includes:

items.essential: Essential cookies that are necessary for the website to function properly
items.analytics: Analytics cookies that help us understand how visitors interact with the website
items.preferences: Preference cookies that allow the website to remember choices you make

managing.title: Managing Cookies
managing.content: Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings preferences. However, if you limit the ability of websites to set cookies, you may worsen your overall user experience.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To provide JKT48 fans with the best tools to track their theater journey and celebrate their fandom.

team.title: The Team
team.content: Built by fans, for fans. We are a community-driven project passionate about JKT48.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.content: MyPage48 is an open-source project. You can find our code on {githubLink}. We believe in transparency—you can verify the source code yourself or even host your own instance for a completely local and private experience.
